title_en: Measures of the Supreme People's Court on the Collection and Payment of Litigation Fees for Various Types of Cases
keywords_en: People's Court concerning all types of its own cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Provisions on the Collection of Litigation Fees for Various Types of Cases in the Supreme People's Court

Fa Fa [2003] No. 15

Article 1 These Provisions are formulated in accordance with the "Functions of the Internal Organs and Newly Established Institutions of the Supreme People's Court", the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Management of Time Limits for Trial of Cases", and the "Measures for the Collection of Litigation Fees in the People's Courts" and its supplementary provisions, in order to regulate the collection of litigation fees for various types of cases in the Supreme People's Court and the handling of applications for deferment, reduction, or exemption of such fees.

Article 2 The collection of litigation fees for various types of cases in the Supreme People's Court and the handling of applications for deferment, reduction, or exemption of such fees shall be uniformly handled by the Case Filing Division.

Article 3 Where an appellate case is submitted by the court of first instance and the parties have already paid the litigation fees, the Case Filing Division shall docket the case and transfer the case file to the relevant trial division.

Where the case file submitted by the court of first instance does not contain a receipt for the payment of litigation fees, nor does it contain the appellant's application for deferment, reduction, or exemption of litigation fees, the Case Filing Division shall issue a notice to the appellant requiring advance payment of the litigation fees. After the litigation fees are fully collected, the Case Filing Division shall docket the case and transfer the case file to the relevant trial division.

Article 4 Where, within seven days from the next day after receiving the notice from the Supreme People's Court requiring advance payment of litigation fees, the appellant neither pays the litigation fees nor submits an application for deferment, reduction, or exemption of litigation fees, and has no other legitimate reasons, the Case Filing Division shall rule that the appeal be treated as withdrawn.

Article 5 Where the appellant submits an application for deferment of litigation fees and, upon review, the Case Filing Division decides to grant the deferment, it shall notify the appellant. The deferment period shall not exceed one month. Where the appellant pays the litigation fees within the approved deferment period, the Case Filing Division shall docket the case and transfer the case file to the relevant trial division. Where payment is not made within the time limit, the Case Filing Division shall rule that the appeal be treated as withdrawn.

Where, upon review, the Case Filing Division considers that the grounds for deferment of litigation fees are not valid, it shall make a decision to deny the deferment and issue a notice to the appellant requiring advance payment of litigation fees. Where payment is not made within the time limit, the Case Filing Division shall rule that the appeal be treated as withdrawn.

Article 6 Where the appellant submits an application for reduction or exemption of litigation fees and, upon review, the Case Filing Division decides to grant the reduction or exemption, it shall notify the appellant. Where the appellant pays the litigation fees in the reduced amount approved within the prescribed time limit, or is approved for exemption of litigation fees, the Case Filing Division shall docket the case and transfer the case file to the relevant trial division.

Where the Case Filing Division considers that the grounds for reduction or exemption of litigation fees are not valid, it shall make a decision to deny the reduction or exemption and issue a notice to the appellant requiring advance payment of litigation fees. Where payment is not made within the time limit, the Case Filing Division shall rule that the appeal be treated as withdrawn.

Article 7 Where the appellant directly files an appeal with the Supreme People's Court and submits an application for deferment, reduction, or exemption of litigation fees, the Case Filing Division shall notify the court of first instance to transfer the case file to the Supreme People's Court. After receiving the case file from the court of first instance, the Case Filing Division shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of Articles 5 and 6 of these Provisions.

Article 8 Where the appellant files an appeal with the Supreme People's Court, pays the litigation fees, and subsequently files an application for withdrawal of the appeal, after docketing the case, the Case Filing Division shall transfer the case file to the relevant trial division for review and decision. If the withdrawal of the appeal is permitted, the appellant shall, with the ruling permitting the withdrawal, go to the Judicial Administration and Equipment Bureau of the Supreme People's Court to handle the formalities for refund of the litigation fees.

Article 9 Where other litigation fees need to be collected during the trial of a case, the relevant trial division shall notify the relevant party to make an advance payment.

Article 10 These Provisions shall come into effect on September 1, 2003.

August 27, 2003
